chapter_title_en: Liu Jing and the True Treasure
chapter_keywords: a record of a mortal's journey to immortality
chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey | Chapter 326: Liu Jing and the True Treasure
chapter_meta_description: Liu Jing faces a crisis of reputation and survival against the Blood Servants, forcing him to burn his ultimate heirloom — a legendary True Treasure. What price is too high for glory?
og_title: Chapter 326: Liu Jing and the True Treasure
og_description: Liu Jing burns his True Treasure to save his reputation from the Black Fiend Sect. Power comes at a cost in the Mortal Stream.
twitter_title: Chapter 326: Liu Jing and the True Treasure
twitter_description: Liu Jing risks a one-time heirloom treasure to protect his image. Sometimes the cost of reputation is higher than any spell.

lore_anchors.definition: A one-time use talisman that can hold up to one-third of the original magic treasure’s power, but requires the user to have the creator’s bloodline and permanently damages the original treasure in the process.
